newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's Telepar H1 net rises vs yr ago.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's Telepar H1 net rises vs yr ago.

text.p: Telecoms operator Telepar, a unit of Brazilian telecom holding Telecomunicacoes Brasileiras S.A. (Telebras) serving Parana state, released the following January-June financial results.
NOTE: The figures are in Brazilian reais and not adjusted for inflation.

In a statement, Telepar said its net profit rose 9.62 percent in the first half compared with January-June 1996 due to an increase in installed capacity, more service, growth in line traffic and cost-containment.

The firm said installed fixed lines totalled 948,589 in June compared with 906,641 in December and 865,599 in June 1996. Cellular terminals in service totalled 869,755 versus 826,841 in December and 781,289 a year ago.
Telepar is formally known as Telecomunicacoes do Parana SA.
